The Router also noted structural collapse and perspective distortion. The Topology Boundary Auditor found a high-confidence mask, but this only confirms segmentation, not geometric correctness. The Perceptual Quality Auditor noted slight compression, missing the more significant AI-induced 'waxy' or 'painted' texture anomalies on the plastic packaging. The severity of the text artifact is catastrophic for realism. The structural warping of the packages (non-Euclidean corners) is a significant geometric defect that supports the 'structural_collapse' observation. I agree with the Router's severity ratings for text and structure, but emphasize that the text failure is the most definitive proof of AI generation here.

The text artifacts further degrade the semantic integrity of the packaging, making the object ambiguous. Only 2 out of 4 testable checkpoints were passed, and one of those (context) is contradicted by the classifier's failure.
